title: Variability of Q gene locus in Ethiopia bread wheat cultivars and breeding lines
author: Gizachew Haile, Gidamo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Grow wheat genotypes in pots
steps.instruction: Plant the 52 wheat genotypes in pots and grow them under standard conditions at Addis Ababa Science and Technology University until the plants reach 20 days old.

steps.title: Harvest tissue from 20‑day plants
steps.instruction: Collect leaf tissue from the 20‑day‑old wheat plants for DNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract DNA with CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from the harvested tissue using a CTAB extraction buffer according to a standard CTAB protocol.

steps.title: Set up PCR for Q‑gene intron
steps.instruction: Prepare PCR reactions using primers designed from the 9th intronic region of the Q gene to amplify the three loci (5AQ, 5BQ, 5DQ).

substeps.instruction: Include primers for 5AQ (expected product 536 bp), 5BQ (665 bp), and 5DQ (578 bp).

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate the PCR products on an agarose gel and visualize the bands with a gel documentation system.

substeps.instruction: Capture images of the gel to record the six allelic variants.
